policy: Assistant-authored Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian and German translations for the actual document replacement/Save As workflow; no HTTP translation service and no native-linguist review. Preserve existing nonempty CSV cells. Authored paths and native filesystem error detail are data, not translated labels.
placeholder_policy: Preserve {path} exactly in Replacement and Active native document format strings.
error_key_verification: The request-identity and recovery errors are actual io.rs user-facing strings. The orphan replacement message is in app.rs and ends with 'was retained', not 'was kept'. These are translations, not technical invariants.
excluded_source_data: untitled.skylive.json is a filename default, not a translatable caption
app_document_tests.rs is a cfg(test) module path, not UI text
authored paths and underlying filesystem errors remain unchanged
csv_publication: Not performed by this agent; root integrates the sidecar with the canonical generator.
